summary: unexpected TOKEN, expected one of: LIST
rationale: The token must fit the current grammar production.
An unknown statement cannot create a model element.
An opened delimiter must close before the input ends.

summary: CONTEXT must be between 0-1 (decimal) or 0-100 (percentage). Received: VALUE
rationale: Upstream rejects used coordinates outside its normalized percentage range.

summary: Pipeline "NAME" must reference an existing component with coordinates.
rationale: A pipeline inherits visibility from an existing parent node.
The builder requires both coordinates for every resolved node.
